infos.name: C14-MOUTH side bays
infos.detail: ABSENT — mouthExposure is a CORNER-framed law (two flank rectangles, one per axis, each running inboard from a nose corner). A side bay has both jaws on one rail and no nose corner, so the cross-rail rectangle lands in open playfield, finds no cushion cloth and trips the fail-closed NO-CLOTH clause: a false red, not a measurement. Side-bay mouth intrusion is judged by the census rows below.
